newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan overnight interbank rate closes higher.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan overnight interbank rate closes higher.

text.p: Taiwan's overnight interbank rate closed firmer on Monday as liquidity remained tight at the end of a reserved period but dealers did not expect further gains in coming sessions.

The rate ended at 6.152 percent compared with Saturday's 5.782, with 30-day commercial paper at 6.30-50 percent against 6.50. Dealers saw limited further gains as liquidity would ease when a new reserve period starts on Wednesday.
In the bond market, the 10-year 84/1 bond yield was at 5.6350-6400. Traders expected bond yields to step slightly lower as liquidity is expected to ease soon. - Julie Hu (2-5080815)
